title.narrative: Implement pilot Innovative and Gender Sensitive Animal Health Approaches

description.narrative: As part of the project activities, one of the aims is to enhance the role of women in the livestock sector and ensure their contribution to it. The project will work to achieve this by engaging women in the delivery of animal health services through innovative and gendersensitive approaches to animal health, as well as by providing the necessary training and loans to equip them with the required animal health equipment and inputs to begin their services.

comment.narrative: The gender sensitive animal health approach is piloted in Amhara and Oromia region and it is in progress at the Somali region. Soon expect to be scaled up by the government and other development partners.

title.narrative: Create Job for unemployed vet graduates

description.narrative: As part of the projects veterinary rationalisation component, encouraging private sector involvement in the veterinary service domain is one of the deliverables. In order to achieve this goal, the project will create an enabling environment for young graduates through capacity building, information dissemination, and loan facilitation for them to start businesses.

comment.narrative: The Job creation pilot program is implemented fully at Ahhara region where the regional microfinanceTsedey Bank already fully lend the allocated budget and they already start to provide additional money from their Own which insure sustainability of the program. In Oromia it is on progress and at Somali region Just starting the implementation process.

title.narrative: Improve the quality of Sheep and Goat Skin Production by Enhancing Animal Health

description.narrative: Improving the quality of sheep and goat skin production is among the project deliverables that will be achieved through various interventions. A number of activities will be conducted to facilitate this, including conducting pre and postcontrol surveys, training AH professionals on ectoparasite control and hide and skin management, conducting ectoparasite control campaigns in selected woredas, conducting supervision and monitoring of ectoparasite control, etc.

comment.narrative: The activity is implemented in the three project regions and the disease burden is reduced as reported. this proves the improvement in skin and hide quality. This need to be scaled up to the other non project areas in a sustainable manner.

title.narrative: Raise the quality of public Veterinary Service delivery performance by adopting OIE Performance criteria

description.narrative: Through Maintenance and Rehabilitation, upgrading the standard of veterinary clinics, equipping, Developing and distributing the SOPS manual for Veterinary Clinics and Health Posts and providing capacitybuilding training for professionals, the Woredalevel veterinary clinics will be strengthened, which intern raise the quality of public Veterinary Service delivery performance. By doing so, the level of advancement of the veterinary service will be improved from the current level of 2.63/5 in the OIE PVS evaluation to 3/5

title.narrative: Increase sustainable livestock productivity and improve the marketing of livestock products

description.narrative: Through the use of animal health intervention, the project aims to improve the overall quality and coverage of animal health services in the country. In this way, the project contributes to the achievement of the national goal, specifically to the increase in sustainable livestock production and the improvement of marketing of livestock products.

title.narrative: Improved quantity of livestock products and increased market access to livestock products in the country

description.narrative: Because of the animal health intervention and the various activities including the awareness creation as well as the public health activities of the HEARD project the quality of the livestock product is improved and access to market is also increased. On the other hand, the attribution level of the project needs to be considered since it works only in 70 Woredas ( 25 in the Somali region) in total, which makes this claim very unrealistic.
